description: This file defines a PromptSecurityGuardrail class that extends CustomGuardrail to implement prompt security features, including file sanitization, message processing, and API interactions for blocking or modifying content based on security policies.

classes.name: PromptSecurityGuardrailMissingSecrets
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating missing secrets for prompt security guardrail.

classes.name: PromptSecurityGuardrail
classes.description: Main class implementing prompt security features, including file sanitization, message filtering, and API interactions for blocking or modifying prompts and responses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the guardrail with API credentials, environment variables, and configuration for file sanitization.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook to process and secure prompt data before execution.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Moderation hook to process and secure prompt data during moderation.

methods.name: sanitize_file_content
methods.description: Uploads and sanitizes a file via external API, polling for results, and returning action, content, and metadata.

methods.name: _process_image_url_item
methods.description: Processes and sanitizes image URL items, potentially modifying or blocking based on security results.

methods.name: _process_document_item
methods.description: Processes and sanitizes document or file items, potentially modifying or blocking based on security results.

methods.name: process_message_files
methods.description: Processes message contents to sanitize embedded files, images, or documents.

methods.name: call_prompt_security_guardrail
methods.description: Main method to process messages, sanitize files, and enforce security actions like block or modify.

methods.name: call_prompt_security_guardrail_on_output
methods.description: Sends output response to API for security review, returning actions and modifications.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-processing hook to modify or block responses based on security review.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
